about: What a person said to a card waiting on their thread, and whether it is a go-ahead (the dashboard's server/ask/act/yes-check.ts).
`action` is the card's own title and terms, as the press joins them; `words` what the person typed or said.

`expect` is true for a go-ahead, false for anything else (a change, a question, a doubt, a no, another card's terms), and null where it is the product's call and not yet made: a run reports those and never judges them.
Every name is made up, and no case names a trade. Cards are in English with words in either language, as an owner who speaks Spanish meets them, and a few cards are in Spanish too.
The live run asks the model (tooling/scripts/evals/yes-check.mjs); tests/ask/act/yes-check-cases.test.mjs holds the set's shape.
